sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:26

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:26:1
items.html: The MA and BON of Gadlut is called an addition that departs: For only what emerged from the beginning of the emanation is regarded as the substance of the Partzuf, that is, the Katnut in it. But whatever it attains afterwards through new couplings is regarded in it as an addition to the substance of its structure, and it is able to depart from it, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:26:2
items.html:
And only the BON of Katnut remains in both of them, and this is in ZON: It appears that it should read, the MA and BON of Katnut, since the essence of Katnut is the MA alone, as above, and even the BON is rooted in the MA and needs it. Yet one may strain to uphold the reading and explain that he calls the MA of Katnut by the name BON because the nursing that reveals the vessels of HGT comes from BON, from the bottom Hey in the Einayim, as above (page 615, the passage beginning “And therefore”); and because this discernment of BON is higher than MA, he therefore calls the whole of VAK [six ends] by the name BON.
Thus the discernments of Ibur [impregnation] and nursing of ZA are reckoned as the substance of the emanation of ZON, namely the lights of Nefesh that are clothed in the vessels of Ibur, and the lights of Ruach that are clothed in the vessels of nursing. But the coupling of Gadlut of MA and BON, which are GAR — and even when they are the GAR of Neshama — is reckoned as an addition, and it departs at the time when there is a cause for departure.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:26:3
items.html: In AVI the MA and BON always remain in them, for they already had at first the complete name BON, at the time of the kings, in all ten Sefirot: This refers to the MA and BON of Gadlut, since the MA and BON of Katnut remain even in ZON, as above. And the reason is that they already had a complete BON at the time of the kings, also with respect to GAR. That is to say, the matter of the nullification of the posterior that occurred in them was not on their own account, but on account of the sons, who are the ZAT, as written there. Hence, once the BON was corrected again with respect to GAR, it is reckoned as the substance of their emanation. And this is the rule: everything that emerged in the world of Nekudim in wholeness is reckoned here, in the world of Atzilut, as the substance of the Partzuf, and once it has been corrected it no longer departs. And although the posterior of AVI of Nekudim was nullified and they returned there to back to back, still, since that diminution to back to back was not on their own account, they are reckoned as whole. Hence, after they were corrected in Atzilut in face to face, they never again return to back to back, as the ARI writes in several places.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:26:4
items.html: Nevertheless, they too needed MA and BON in the manner mentioned above regarding ZON: That is to say, although they already had a complete BON of ten Sefirot at the time of the kings — which availed them so that the MA and BON of Gadlut would not depart from them — still, since before they were corrected there was in them a nullification of the posterior, it therefore needs sweetening and correction from the MA, and it must first come into union with the MA before it clothes in the vessels of the female, as above with ZON. And for this reason there is MA and BON in the male, and MA and BON in the female, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:26:5
items.html: Their root is judgments and not mercy, even though they are MA: That is to say, the root of the judgments is there, for from Bina the judgments are awakened, in the secret of the Butzina de Kardinuta [the lamp of darkness] that is concealed in the womb of Bina. And this will be explained in its place.
